COG.note: Page covers tax and customs payment, not public procurement.
Page states nothing on central bank mandate, licensing, switch or PAPSS.
Page states no consumer rules or redress; it only notes the transaction is free.
Page is domestic only; no cross-border corridor stated.
Page covers payments to government, not government payments to people.
No survey figure on account ownership.

facts.fact: MTN Congo's product page describes MTN Mobile Money as a working payment method for e-tax and e-douane bills, with a free transaction for amounts of 1 to 750,000 FCFA.
MTN Congo's page says taxpayers fill in their tax declaration on impots.gouv.cg and pay e-tax and e-douane bills by MTN Mobile Money, free of charge, from 1 to 750,000 FCFA.
MTN Congo's page says taxpayers create an account on impots.gouv.cg and fill in their tax declaration online.
MTN Congo's page says the e-tax declaration is paid through the payment-method step by choosing MTN Mobile Money, free of charge, from 1 to 750,000 FCFA.
